message.content: This case concerns whether extension staff can cite a field sample as meeting the wetness target for Plot W during the Copper Reed trial. Claim A, that Plot W was in the center of the block, is contradicted by the field map (S2), which shows it as an outside plot. Claim B, that Plot W was sampled at noon, is supported by the signed collection tag (S3). Claim C, that Plot W was below the moisture target at noon, remains unresolved: while a supervisor observed a dry upper surface suggesting low moisture (S1), the sampling procedure measures deeper soil moisture, so this observation does not confirm the plot was below the target. Thus, there is insufficient evidence to confirm the sample met or failed the wetness target.
